description: This file defines a mock class 'ClientMock' for the 'IClient' interface used in IPC testing within the Rialto project. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for client-related functionalities such as retrieving client process IDs, user IDs, group IDs, disconnecting, exporting services, sending events, and checking connection status.

classes.name: ClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IClient interface for testing IPC client interactions.

methods.name: getClientPid
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the client's process ID.

methods.name: getClientUserId
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the client's user ID.

methods.name: getClientGroupId
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the client's group ID.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Mock method to disconnect the client.

methods.name: exportService
methods.description: Mock method to export a service to the client.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Mock method to send an event message to the client.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Mock method to check if the client is connected.
